title: Need honst Feedback on my Rougle Like Shooter
author: Substantial-Mix-3772
selftext:
[Youtube Trailer Old Version ](https://youtu.be/tkctaA9vnpo?si=SmJ43ZEQBBL90vml)

[direct download github](https://github.com/OsuGerman/Tiefgang-Releases/releases/latest/download/Tiefgang-Windows.zip)

[Project Website](https://osugerman.github.io/Tiefgang-Releases/)

  
TIEFGANG is a deep-sea roguelike shooter I'm building. You dive into the ruins of a sunken civilization: coral cathedrals, drowned archives, ancient temples and a graveyard of ships. Each run takes you deeper. You fight your way through rooms, pick weapons, blessings and charms, and build combos that shouldn't work. Beat the bosses, survive the depths, and climb 10 pressure levels if you dare. Solo or co-op with up to 4 players.

It's a free test build, so expect rough edges. That's exactly why I need you.

**What I'd love to know:**

* Is it fun? When were you hooked, and when were you bored?
* Do weapons, enemies and builds feel good and fair?
* Anything confusing, ugly, buggy or too hard or too easy?
